## Documentation

Send a new poll.

**Available to:** User accounts and bots.

### Parameters

- **`chat_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the target chat.
  For your personal cloud (Saved Messages) you can simply use "me" or "self".
  For a contact that exists in your Telegram address book you can use his phone number (str).
  You can also use chat public link in form of *t.me/<username>* (str).

- **`question`** (`str`)
  Poll question, 1-255 characters.

- **`options`** (List of [`PollOption`](../../types/messages_and_media/PollOption.md))
  List of PollOption.

- **`question_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../../types/messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md), *optional*)
  List of special entities that appear in the poll question, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*.

- **`is_anonymous`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the poll needs to be anonymous.
  Defaults to True.

- **`type`** (:obj`~pyrogram.enums.PollType`, *optional*)
  Poll type, `QUIZ` or `REGULAR`.
  Defaults to `REGULAR`.

- **`allows_multiple_answers`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the poll allows multiple answers, ignored for polls in quiz mode.
  Defaults to False.

- **`correct_option_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  0-based identifier of the correct answer option, required for polls in quiz mode.

- **`explanation`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style
  poll, 0-200 characters with at most 2 line feeds after entities parsing.
  Like the correct options and *explanation_media*, ignored for regular polls.

- **`explanation_parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  By default, texts are parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.
  You can combine both syntaxes together.

- **`explanation_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../../types/messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md))
  List of special entities that appear in the poll explanation, which can be specified instead of
  *parse_mode*.

- **`open_period`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation, 5-600.
  Can't be used together with *close_date*.

- **`close_date`** (`datetime`, *optional*)
  Point in time when the poll will be automatically closed.
  Must be at least 5 and no more than 600 seconds in the future.
  Can't be used together with *open_period*.

- **`is_closed`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True, if the poll needs to be immediately closed.
  This can be useful for poll preview.

- **`disable_notification`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Sends the message silently.
  Users will receive a notification with no sound.

- **`protect_content`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving.

- **`allow_paid_broadcast`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True to allow the message to ignore regular broadcast limits for a small fee; for bots only

- **`message_thread_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of the forum.
  for forum supergroups only.

- **`business_connection_id`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Business connection identifier.
  for business bots only.

- **`reply_to_message_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  If the message is a reply, ID of the original message.

- **`reply_to_chat_id`** (`int` | `str`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier for the origin chat.
  for reply to message from another chat.
  You can also use chat public link in form of *t.me/<username>* (str).

- **`quote_text`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Text to quote.
  for reply_to_message only.

- **`quote_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../../types/messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md), *optional*)
  List of special entities that appear in quote_text, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*.
  for reply_to_message only.

- **`parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  By default, quote_text are parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.
  You can combine both syntaxes together.
  For quote_text.

- **`schedule_date`** (`datetime`, *optional*)
  Date when the message will be automatically sent.

- **`message_effect_id`** (`int` `64-bit`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only.

- **`reply_markup`** ([`InlineKeyboardMarkup`](../../types/bots_and_keyboards/InlineKeyboardMarkup.md) | [`ReplyKeyboardMarkup`](../../types/bots_and_keyboards/ReplyKeyboardMarkup.md) | [`ReplyKeyboardRemove`](../../types/bots_and_keyboards/ReplyKeyboardRemove.md) | [`ForceReply`](../../types/bots_and_keyboards/ForceReply.md), *optional*)
  Additional interface options. An object for an inline keyboard, custom reply keyboard,
  instructions to remove reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.

- **`description`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Description of the poll, shown as the caption of the poll message.

- **`description_parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  By default, the description is parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.

- **`description_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../../types/messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md), *optional*)
  List of special entities that appear in the description, which can be specified instead of
  *description_parse_mode*.

- **`media`** ([`InputMediaPhoto`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaPhoto.md) | [`InputMediaVideo`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaVideo.md) | [`InputMediaAnimation`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaAnimation.md) | [`InputMediaAudio`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaAudio.md) | [`InputMediaDocument`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaDocument.md), *optional*)
  Media attached to the poll. Options can carry media too, see [`PollOption`](../../types/messages_and_media/PollOption.md).

- **`allows_revoting`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass False to forbid changing the vote.

- **`allow_adding_options`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True to let users add answer options to a regular poll; not supported in channels and for
  anonymous polls.

- **`shuffle_options`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True to show the options in a fixed random order.

- **`hide_results_until_closes`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True to show the results only after the poll closes.

- **`members_only`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  Pass True to let only users that are members of the chat for more than a day vote; for channels only.

- **`country_codes`** (List of `str`, *optional*)
  Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries whose users can vote; for channels only.

- **`correct_option_ids`** (List of `int`, *optional*)
  0-based identifiers of the correct answer options of a quiz, if it has several; can be passed
  instead of *correct_option_id*.

- **`explanation_media`** ([`InputMediaPhoto`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaPhoto.md) | [`InputMediaVideo`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaVideo.md) | [`InputMediaAnimation`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaAnimation.md) | [`InputMediaAudio`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaAudio.md) | [`InputMediaDocument`](../../types/input_media/InputMediaDocument.md), *optional*)
  Media shown with the explanation of a quiz.

- **`question_parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  By default, *question* is parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.
  You can combine both syntaxes together.

### Returns

[`Message`](../../types/messages_and_media/Message.md): On success, the sent poll message is returned.

### Raises

ValueError: In case *explanation_entities* are passed without *explanation*.

### Example

```python
from pyrogram.types import PollOption

await app.send_poll(
    chat_id,
    "Is this a poll question?",
    [
        PollOption("Yes"),
        PollOption("No"),
        PollOption("Maybe")
    ]
)
```
